text:
The plate holds about 10–12 pieces of pale green fruit that looks like honeydew melon or cucumber, plus about 7 yellow pineapple pieces.

Melon: each piece is about 8 g, so about 12 pieces is roughly 95 g. At about 0.36 kcal/g, that is about 34 kcal.

Pineapple: each piece is about 10–12 g, so 7 pieces is roughly 75 g. At about 0.5 kcal/g, that is about 38 kcal.

Total: about 170 g and about 72 kcal.
